dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "What are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing?"

dialogues.jp:
表情を変えずに砂の中から手を引き抜き、再び
砂を盛っていくところも子供の頃と変わらない。
dialogues.en: "I came to get you, Moe-sempai."
dialogues.text: "I came to get you, Moe-sempai."

dialogues.jp:
俺は公園の土を踏みしめて、砂場に近づいていっ
た。
dialogues.en: I spoke to her softly with real determination.
dialogues.text: I spoke to her softly with real determination.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くん……こんにちは」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sorry...... I'm waiting for someone. I can't go home
until I see him."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sorry...... I'm waiting for someone. I can't go home
until I see him."

dialogues.jp:
寂しげな表情に無理矢理、重ねたような微笑み
を浮かべる。
dialogues.en:
"I know. You're waiting for your childhood friend,
Keiichi-kun, right?"
dialogues.text:
"I know. You're waiting for your childhood friend,
Keiichi-kun, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんですか？」
穏やかに、しかし決意を込めて言う。
dialogues.en: She nodded quietly.
dialogues.text: She nodded quietly.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんなさい……待っている人がいるんです。
　その人と会うまでは、今日は帰れません」
dialogues.en:
"He's my first and only friend. He comes here when I'm
digging the tunnel like this."
dialogues.text:
"He's my first and only friend. He comes here when I'm
digging the tunnel like this."

dialogues.jp: コクリ、と静かに首を縦に振る萌先輩。
dialogues.en: Her dry hands were full of sand, and her skin was peeling.
dialogues.text: Her dry hands were full of sand, and her skin was peeling.

dialogues.jp:
砂だらけの萌先輩の手は、かさかさに乾いて、
少し皮が｛む／剥｝けているようだった。
dialogues.en:
I wonder how many times she tried to dig a tunnel with those
skinny hands.
dialogues.text:
I wonder how many times she tried to dig a tunnel with those
skinny hands.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「いつも、手が痛くなった頃にやって来るんで
　すよ。そして、砂山にトンネルを掘ってくれ
　るんです」
dialogues.en:
"He always shows up by the time my hands start hurting. Then
he digs a tunnel with me."
dialogues.text:
"He always shows up by the time my hands start hurting. Then
he digs a tunnel with me."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「私、一度もトンネル、ひとりで掘れたことな
　くて……」
dialogues.en: "I've never dug a tunnel all by myself."
dialogues.text: "I've never dug a tunnel all by myself."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「私、ドジだから何度教えてもらっても、途中
　で崩れてしまうんです……」
dialogues.en:
"He taught me so many times, but it would always collapse
because I'm too slow."
dialogues.text:
"He taught me so many times, but it would always collapse
because I'm too slow."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「でも、その幼なじみの男の子――啓一くんは、
　交通事故で死んでしまっているんでしょう？」
dialogues.en:
"But your childhood friend ? Keiichi-kun ? he died in a
accident, right?"
dialogues.text:
"But your childhood friend ? Keiichi-kun ? he died in a
accident, right?"

dialogues.jp: 俺の言葉に、萌先輩が悲しげに頷く。
dialogues.en:
Moe nodded with a sad face when I asked her the difficult
question.
dialogues.text:
Moe nodded with a sad face when I asked her the difficult
question.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「啓くんは、私を庇って交通事故に遭いました。
　でも、啓くんの魂は私の身体に宿って、今も
　生きているんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Kei-kun got into that accident trying to save me. Kei-kun's
spirit is still resting with me, and he's alive inside of
me."
dialogues.text:
"Kei-kun got into that accident trying to save me. Kei-kun's
spirit is still resting with me, and he's alive inside of
me."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「だから、会えるんです」
dialogues.en: "That's why I can see him."
dialogues.text: "That's why I can see him."

dialogues.jp:
そう言いながら、悲しげに微笑む萌先輩は、ど
こか諦めているようにも見える。
dialogues.en:
She smiled sadly as she spoke, but her expression seemed as
if she was starting to give up.
dialogues.text:
She smiled sadly as she spoke, but her expression seemed as
if she was starting to give up.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩も本当は分かっているのかもしれない。
それが単なる｛ごまか／誤魔化｝しだってことに……。
dialogues.en:
Perhaps she already understands...... that it's just an
illusion.
dialogues.text:
Perhaps she already understands...... that it's just an
illusion.

dialogues.jp:
それを、ちゃんと認識させてあげなくちゃなら
ない。そのために、俺は来たのだから……。
dialogues.en: I have to make her accept reality. That's why I'm here......
dialogues.text: I have to make her accept reality. That's why I'm here......

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩――」
dialogues.en: "Moe-sempai......?"
dialogues.text: "Moe-sempai......?"

dialogues.jp:
「先輩はいつまでそうやって現実から目をそむ
　け続けているつもりですか？」
dialogues.en: "When are you going to stop looking away from reality?"
dialogues.text: "When are you going to stop looking away from reality?"

dialogues.jp: 蒼白になる先輩に、俺はさらに言葉を続ける。
dialogues.en: I continued to speak as she turned pale.
dialogues.text: I continued to speak as she turned pale.

dialogues.jp:
「そうやって現実の生活から逃げて、夢の世界
　に浸っていたんじゃ、命懸けで萌先輩を助け
　た啓一くんが浮かばれない」
dialogues.en:
"If you keep on running away from reality and living in your
dream, Keiichi-kun won't be able to rest in peace. He saved
you with his life!"
dialogues.text:
"If you keep on running away from reality and living in your
dream, Keiichi-kun won't be able to rest in peace. He saved
you with his life!"

dialogues.jp:
「どうして、啓一くんが萌先輩を助けたと思っ
　てるんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Why do you think Keiichi-kun saved you?"
dialogues.text: "Why do you think Keiichi-kun saved you?"

dialogues.jp:
「萌先輩に生きて、そして幸せになって欲しい
　からじゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "It's because he wanted you to live a happy life!"
dialogues.text: "It's because he wanted you to live a happy life!"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「それは……」

萌先輩は表情を無くし、唇を微かに振るわせて
いる。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai had no expression left on her face, as her lips
quivered slightly.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai had no expression left on her face, as her lips
quivered slightly.

dialogues.jp:
見ていて辛いものがあるが、それでも言ってあ
げなければならない。
dialogues.en:
It was difficult to see her like this, but I had to tell her
the truth.
dialogues.text:
It was difficult to see her like this, but I had to tell her
the truth.

dialogues.jp:
「啓一くんは、萌先輩が過去に縛られて生きて
　いくことなんか、望んでないはずです」
dialogues.en:
"Keiichi-kun doesn't want you to be strangled by the past.
He wants you to live a happy life."
dialogues.text:
"Keiichi-kun doesn't want you to be strangled by the past.
He wants you to live a happy life."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「でも、私のせいで啓くんは死んでしまったん
　です。だから、私が啓くんのことを忘れては
　ダメなんです」
dialogues.en:
"But Keiichi-kun died because of me. That's why I must never
forget him."
dialogues.text:
"But Keiichi-kun died because of me. That's why I must never
forget him."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「私……約束したんです……『ずっと一緒に遊
　ぼうね』って」
dialogues.en:
"I made a promise with him...... that we would play together
forever."
dialogues.text:
"I made a promise with him...... that we would play together
forever."

dialogues.jp:
｛とまど／躊躇｝うような苦悩の表情を浮かべ、精一杯そう
口にする。
dialogues.en: As she spoke, she began to look confused.
dialogues.text: As she spoke, she began to look confused.

dialogues.jp: 「でも、それじゃ誰も幸せにはなれません」
dialogues.en: "But that isn't going to make anyone happy."
dialogues.text: "But that isn't going to make anyone happy."

dialogues.jp:
「啓一くんのためと言って萌先輩が自分の幸せ
　を捨てても、逆に彼を苦しめるだけです」
dialogues.en:
"If you throw away your happiness for Keiichi-kun, it'll
only make him feel sad."
dialogues.text:
"If you throw away your happiness for Keiichi-kun, it'll
only make him feel sad."

dialogues.jp:
「萌先輩がしなきゃいけないことは、啓一くん
　を自分の夢の中に閉じ込めておくことじゃな
　いはずです」
dialogues.en:
"What you need to do for him is to not trap Keiichi-kun
inside of your dream."
dialogues.text:
"What you need to do for him is to not trap Keiichi-kun
inside of your dream."

dialogues.jp:
「しっかりと前に向かって歩いて、彼の生きた
　証になることじゃないんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"You need to move forward in order to become the proof of
his life."
dialogues.text:
"You need to move forward in order to become the proof of
his life."

dialogues.jp:
すっかり影の長くなった公園を、しばらく静寂
が包む。見下ろす視線の先に、｛うつむ／俯｝いた萌先輩の
姿がある。
dialogues.en:
As the shadows were getting longer, the park was surrounded
by silence. Moe-sempai was looking away as I looked down
toward her.
dialogues.text:
As the shadows were getting longer, the park was surrounded
by silence. Moe-sempai was looking away as I looked down
toward her.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「分かってるんです……啓くんはこんなこと望
　んでないって……」
dialogues.en: "I know...... I know that this isn't what Kei-kun wants."
dialogues.text: "I know...... I know that this isn't what Kei-kun wants."

dialogues.jp:
下を向いたままの萌先輩の口元から、涙にかす
れた声が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en:
I heard her cracked voice coming out of her mouth as she
continued to look down.
dialogues.text:
I heard her cracked voice coming out of her mouth as she
continued to look down.

dialogues.jp:
顔を上げた萌先輩の瞳には、大粒の涙が溢れて
いた。
dialogues.en: When she looked up, her eyes were full of tears.
dialogues.text: When she looked up, her eyes were full of tears.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「でも、私……自分のせいで啓くんを死なせて
　しまったことが怖くて、啓くんが側にいない
　のが寂しくって……」
dialogues.en:
"But...... I'm scared that Kei-kun died because of me......
and I'm sad that he's not here any more......"
dialogues.text:
"But...... I'm scared that Kei-kun died because of me......
and I'm sad that he's not here any more......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「どうしようもなく、心が押し潰されそうで
　……」
dialogues.en: "I feel overwhelmed......"
dialogues.text: "I feel overwhelmed......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そんな時、夢を見たんです」
dialogues.en: "That's when I saw his dream."
dialogues.text: "That's when I saw his dream."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「啓くん、いつも通りに、優しく笑ってて……
　『大丈夫、僕はここにいるよ』って、言って
　くれたんです」
dialogues.en:
"Kei-kun was smiling at me softly like he used to...... and
he told me that everything's fine...... that he's still
here."
dialogues.text:
"Kei-kun was smiling at me softly like he used to...... and
he told me that everything's fine...... that he's still
here."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「私、嬉しくって……それからは、眠れば必ず
　啓くんに会えて、私の言ったことに答えてく
　れるんです。夢の中なのに、話せるんです」
dialogues.en:
"I was so happy...... Since then I was able to see Kei-kun
in my dream all the time. He answered my questions in my
dream, and we were able to talk."
dialogues.text:
"I was so happy...... Since then I was able to see Kei-kun
in my dream all the time. He answered my questions in my
dream, and we were able to talk."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「だから、私は啓くんの魂が私の身体の中にい
　るんだって、思うことにしたんです」
dialogues.en:
"That's why I started believing that Kei-kun's spirit is
living inside of me. I believed that spirits do exist."
dialogues.text:
"That's why I started believing that Kei-kun's spirit is
living inside of me. I believed that spirits do exist."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「魂って言葉があるんだから、魂は本当に存在
　するんだって……」
dialogues.en:
"I believed that the Kei-kun in my dreams is really him. It
made me feel better to think that way."
dialogues.text:
"I believed that the Kei-kun in my dreams is really him. It
made me feel better to think that way."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「だから夢の中の啓くんは、本物の啓くんだっ
　て。そう思ったら心が楽になったんです」
dialogues.en:
"I started sleeping a lot in order to see him...... and I
started taking sleeping pills......"
dialogues.text:
"I started sleeping a lot in order to see him...... and I
started taking sleeping pills......"

dialogues.jp: ｛せき／堰｝を切ったように、溜め込んでいた思いを語る。
dialogues.en:
She started talking as if the dam had broken, and she
couldn't keep it in any more.
dialogues.text:
She started talking as if the dam had broken, and she
couldn't keep it in any more.

dialogues.jp:
溢れる涙に押し流されたように、｛はかな／儚｝げな表情が
消えていた。
dialogues.en:
Her empty expression was being washed away with her flowing
tears.
dialogues.text:
Her empty expression was being washed away with her flowing
tears.

dialogues.jp: 乾いた砂に涙がこぼれる。
dialogues.en: Her tears dropped into the dry sand.
dialogues.text: Her tears dropped into the dry sand.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「でも、それはいけないことだったんですね。
　啓くんが命をかけて守ってくれた私の人生を
　無駄にしちゃいけなかった……」
dialogues.en:
"But I guess this wasn't the right way. I can't waste the
life that Kei-kun saved for me......"
dialogues.text:
"But I guess this wasn't the right way. I can't waste the
life that Kei-kun saved for me......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「でも、啓くんがいないと、私はひとりだった
　から……」
dialogues.en: "But without Kei-kun, I'm all alone......"
dialogues.text: "But without Kei-kun, I'm all alone......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「先輩はひとりじゃないよ。いつも、啓一くん
　が見守っていてくれてるし、眞子だって心配
　している」
dialogues.en:
"You aren't alone. Keiichi-chan's always looking after you,
and Mako's worried about you too."
dialogues.text:
"You aren't alone. Keiichi-chan's always looking after you,
and Mako's worried about you too."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「それに俺だっているしね。俺は“萌”のこと
　……好きだよ。ずっと側に居たいし……居て
　ほしい」
dialogues.en:
"I'm here too. Moe...... I love you. I want to be by your
side forever, and I want you to be near me."
dialogues.text:
"I'm here too. Moe...... I love you. I want to be by your
side forever, and I want you to be near me."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「私も、朝倉くんのこと……好きです。啓くん
　の守ってくれた人生を幸せに過ごしたいです」
dialogues.en:
"I love you too, Asakura-kun...... I want to spend the rest
of the life that Kei-kun saved happily with you."
dialogues.text:
"I love you too, Asakura-kun...... I want to spend the rest
of the life that Kei-kun saved happily with you."

dialogues.jp: 久しぶりに見る、萌の優しげな笑み。
dialogues.en:
I haven't seen her soft smile in a while. She was smiling at
me as if she'd overcome all of her obstacles.
dialogues.text:
I haven't seen her soft smile in a while. She was smiling at
me as if she'd overcome all of her obstacles.

dialogues.jp:
心のしこりの取れた、会心の笑みを浮かべてい
る。
dialogues.en: "Let's dig the tunnel together."
dialogues.text: "Let's dig the tunnel together."

dialogues.jp: 「トンネル、ふたりで完成させようか」
dialogues.en:
I squatted in front of Moe and formed a firm mountain with
my hands. Then I started digging from the other side.
dialogues.text:
I squatted in front of Moe and formed a firm mountain with
my hands. Then I started digging from the other side.

dialogues.jp:
俺は萌の前にしゃがみ込み、砂山をしっかりと
押し固め、反対側から掘り進める。
dialogues.en: We remained silent and dug carefully.
dialogues.text: We remained silent and dug carefully.

dialogues.jp: 互いに黙ったまま、丁寧に掘り進めていく。
dialogues.en: We dug slowly but surely......
dialogues.text: We dug slowly but surely......

dialogues.jp: 焦らず、ゆっくりと――。
dialogues.en:
The thin wall of sand broke, and I felt Moe's fingertips
touching my dry fingers.
dialogues.text:
The thin wall of sand broke, and I felt Moe's fingertips
touching my dry fingers.

dialogues.jp:
薄い砂の壁が崩れ、俺の指先に少しカサついて
しまった萌の指先が絡まる。
dialogues.en: I held onto her hand tightly and stared into her eyes.
dialogues.text: I held onto her hand tightly and stared into her eyes.

dialogues.jp: 指先でしっかりと握り合い、萌の瞳を見つめる。
dialogues.en:
"You don't have to dig all by yourself. We can live together
just like we dug this tunnel together."
dialogues.text:
"You don't have to dig all by yourself. We can live together
just like we dug this tunnel together."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「ふたりで……そうですね。ひとりでがんばる
　必要、ないんですよね……」
dialogues.en:
"Together...... that's true. I don't need to struggle all by
myself, huh?"
dialogues.text:
"Together...... that's true. I don't need to struggle all by
myself, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「これから……ふたりで……いろんなことを
　……して……」
dialogues.en: "We can...... do lots of things...... together......"
dialogues.text: "We can...... do lots of things...... together......"

dialogues.jp: ふっと、握られた手から力が抜ける。
dialogues.en: Suddenly she lost the energy in her hands.
dialogues.text: Suddenly she lost the energy in her hands.

dialogues.jp:
フワッと、スローモーションでも見ているかの
ように、萌の身体が砂山の上に倒れかかり、完
成したばかりのトンネルを押し潰す。
dialogues.en:
She collapsed onto the sand mountain as if she was in slow
motion, crushing our tunnel.
dialogues.text:
She collapsed onto the sand mountain as if she was in slow
motion, crushing our tunnel.

dialogues.en: "What......? Moe?"
dialogues.text: "What......? Moe?"

dialogues.jp: 砂の中にうつ伏せに倒れた萌を仰向けにする。
dialogues.en: I turned over her body.
dialogues.text: I turned over her body.

dialogues.jp: ――ザスッ
dialogues.en: ----Thud.
dialogues.text: ----Thud.

dialogues.jp: 「これは……」
砂の上に、何かが落ちる。
dialogues.en: Something fell on the sand.
dialogues.text: Something fell on the sand.

dialogues.jp: いつも萌が飲んでいた薬のビンが、目にとまる。
dialogues.en: I saw a bottle of the pills Moe used to take.
dialogues.text: I saw a bottle of the pills Moe used to take.

dialogues.jp: 中には空気しか入ってなかった。
dialogues.en: But there was nothing but air inside the bottle.
dialogues.text: But there was nothing but air inside the bottle.

dialogues.jp: ◆夢の終わり◆
dialogues.en: ◆She's here......◆
dialogues.text: ◆She's here......◆

dialogues.jp:
果たして萌先輩はそこにいた。じっと砂の山を
見つめている。先輩を迎えに来たと言うと、帰
れないと言われた。
dialogues.en:
Just like in my dream, Moe-sempai was trying to dig a tunnel
through the sand mountain.
dialogues.text:
Just like in my dream, Moe-sempai was trying to dig a tunnel
through the sand mountain.

dialogues.jp:
先輩は、啓一くんを待っていた。死んでしまっ
たはずの少年は、萌先輩の心の中にずっと住ん
でいる――先輩はそう言った。
dialogues.en: She was sitting in the sandbox, just moving her hands.
dialogues.text: She was sitting in the sandbox, just moving her hands.

dialogues.jp:
先輩は、自分のせいで死んでしまったことが怖
くて、そして、少年が傍にいないことが寂しく
て……そして自分を偽ってきたようだった。
dialogues.en:
The sand collapsed on her hands as it followed her slow
movement.
dialogues.text:
The sand collapsed on her hands as it followed her slow
movement.

dialogues.jp:
そんな時に見た夢。そこには確かにあの日の少
年がいたのだと言う。夢の中に行けば、いつで
も会うことができたのだ、と。

そして、自分の中にいると思い込み、無理矢理
信じ込んで、夢を見るために睡眠薬まで使って
――先輩は｛せき／堰｝を切ったように語った。
dialogues.en:
She took her hands out of the sand and continued to make a
sand mountain just like when she was a child.
dialogues.text:
She took her hands out of the sand and continued to make a
sand mountain just like when she was a child.

dialogues.jp:
でも、先輩もやっとそれが偽りで、まやかしだ
ということに気付いてくれた。少年が守った命
を、そんな形で無駄にしちゃいけない、と。
dialogues.en: I stepped into the park and went closer to the sandbox.
dialogues.text: I stepped into the park and went closer to the sandbox.

dialogues.jp:
一人ぼっちだったという萌先輩に、俺もいるし
眞子だっている、と伝えた。そして俺は初めて
彼女を”萌”と名で呼んだ。
dialogues.en: "Sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Sempai?"

dialogues.jp:
そうしてから、俺たちは二人で協力して、トン
ネルを掘り始めた。また最初から、二人で始め
ていけば良い。
dialogues.en: She slightly moved her eyes and looked up at me.
dialogues.text: She slightly moved her eyes and looked up at me.

dialogues.jp:
掘りながら、萌の体がふらっと揺れた。そして
スローモーションのように、緩慢とした動作で、
その体を砂の上に横たえた。
dialogues.en: "Hello...... Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Hello...... Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
そこで俺は、空になった睡眠薬の入っていたビ
ンを見つけた。
dialogues.en: She forced a smile on top of her sad expression.
dialogues.text: She forced a smile on top of her sad expression.
